# Story 9.1: Unit tests for consistent MM/DD/YYYY date format in tables

Status: done

## Story

As a developer,
I want a red-phase unit-test scaffold asserting that every table date column renders as `MM/DD/YYYY`,
So that Story 9.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it replaces the remaining locale-dependent `shortDate` usages with an explicit `'MM/dd/yyyy'` format.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A unit test renders `BaseTableComponent` with a `type: 'date'` column and asserts the rendered body cell text matches the `MM/DD/YYYY` pattern (e.g. `07/14/2026`) — NOT the locale-dependent `shortDate` form (`M/d/yy`, e.g. `7/14/26`).
2. A unit test renders `OpenPositionsComponent` with a row whose `exDate` is set and asserts the Ex-Date cell text matches `MM/DD/YYYY`.
3. All new assertions in this story are marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) in code so CI stays green while the format is not yet standardized; every pre-existing test remains unskipped and green.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Task 1: Add red-phase tests for base-table date formatting (AC: #1)
  - [x] 1.1 In `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.spec.ts` (or a sibling spec), render with a `{ field: 'asOf', header: 'As Of', type: 'date' }` column and a known date value; assert the cell text is `MM/DD/YYYY`.
- [x] Task 2: Add red-phase test for open-positions Ex-Date (AC: #2)
  - [x] 2.1 In `apps/dms-material/src/app/account-panel/open-positions/open-positions.component.spec.ts` (or a sibling spec), render with a row whose `exDate` is set; assert the Ex-Date cell text is `MM/DD/YYYY`.
- [x] Task 3: Mark all new tests `.skip()` so CI stays green (AC: #3)
  - [x] 3.1 Prefix each new `it(...)` with `.skip` and add a comment noting Story 9.2 removes the skips, confirms red, then implements until green.

## Dev Notes

- Red-phase TDD convention: this story writes failing tests marked `.skip()` in code so CI stays green; Story 9.2's FIRST task is to remove those skips, confirm they fail (red), then implement until green.
- **Current state verified on disk:** the app locale is `en-US` (`MAT_DATE_LOCALE` provided in `apps/dms-material/src/app/app.config.ts:136`). Two table date renderings still use the locale-dependent `'shortDate'` format, which under en-US renders as `M/d/yy` (e.g. `7/14/26`) — not the required `MM/DD/YYYY`:
  - `apps/dms-material/src/app/shared/components/base-table/base-table.component.html:150` — the shared `#defaultCell` date case (`{{ row[column.field] | date: 'shortDate' }}`). This drives **Sold Positions** Buy Date / Sell Date (sold-positions passes no custom cell template, so it uses this default).
  - `apps/dms-material/src/app/account-panel/open-positions/open-positions.component.html` — the open-positions custom `#cellTemplate` date case (`{{ row[column.field] | date : 'shortDate' }}`). This drives **Open Positions** Ex-Date / Buy Date / Sell Date.
- **Already correct (do NOT change):** dividend-deposits and global-universe already render dates as `'MM/dd/yyyy'`. Only the two `shortDate` sites above are out of spec.
- **Why explicit format over locale:** `shortDate` output depends on the active locale; pinning `'MM/dd/yyyy'` makes every table date column identical regardless of locale, which is what "consistently formatted as MM/DD/YYYY" requires.

### Project Structure Notes

- Add: new `it` blocks in the base-table spec and the open-positions spec (or sibling specs). No production code changes in this story.
- No conflict: pure test scaffold; it does not modify templates.
